clauses.title: Exact autofix verifies one versioned labelled evidence envelope
requires: `schemaVersion`
an unknown or absent version fails closed before any field is read
each `fingerprint_*` operation emits its own labelled record and envelope assembly carries it unchanged
every fingerprint travels as `{ domain, encoding, value }`
a record whose `domain` differs from the field holding it is rejected
`raw_bytes`, `normalized_text`, and `canonical_json` are distinct byte domains
moved capture bracket
incomplete pagination
a value retyped by hand into a well-formed record is not detectable here
`evidence_verify` is read-only and repeatable
every identity field or fingerprint value differing from the expected target

clauses.title: The CLI declares evidence_verify and its inputs
requires: evidence_verify: { required: ['envelope', 'expected'], optional: [] },

clauses.title: The driver runs evidence_verify on the assembled evidence before each gate
requires: run.op('evidence_verify', { envelope: { schemaVersion: 1, captureIdentity, brackets: { before: snapshot.before, after: snapshot.after }

clauses.title: README documents the envelope and its preflight verifier
requires: one versioned evidence envelope and a read-only preflight verifier
each fingerprint carries its own domain label
an unknown or absent schema version fails closed before any field is read
rejected before a gate is invoked

clauses.title: Black-box envelope tests pin the version, the labels, and the rejections
requires: an unknown or absent schema version fails closed
a record whose domain differs from its field is rejected
every fingerprint operation owns the labelled record used by envelope assembly
each domain declares one byte domain and one value shape
a moved capture bracket is rejected
incomplete pagination or completeness metadata is rejected
the envelope is compared against the expected target identity
every fingerprint is compared against its expected value
lifecycle and branch identity are validated and compared
both brackets must agree with the captured identity
both brackets witness repository and pull-request number
the envelope is closed and the verifier is read-only and repeatable
the packaged CLI routes evidence_verify under JSON v1
compile/contract RED, not behavioral RED
review-driven regressions added after Sol raised
